title: Comment on "Peculiar Scaling of Self-Avoiding Walk Contacts"
abstract: We demonstrate that the recently proposed Interacting Growth Walk (cond-mat/0108097) does not have the contact-scaling behaviour of Self-Avoiding Walk (M. Baiesi, E. Orlandini and A. L. Stella, Phys. Rev. Lett. 87, 070602 (2001)) at finite temperatures.
